card_templates.name: Guided dialogue replay
card_templates.purpose: Default template for beginner scenario cards: show one complete visual dialogue, replay the cue, prompt the learner to speak in context, then let the AI judge whether the attempt fits the scene.

first_watch: Rotate frames as each dialogue line plays.
Show a green listening glow while audio is playing.
Hide inactive controls during the autoplay.
practice_turn: Replay the scene partner cue line while showing its frame.
Switch to the learner frame after the cue.
Start microphone recording after the cue finishes.
Show a blue glow and 'Now you try' only while the microphone is actually listening.
Hold the learner frame during recording and AI checking.
Show a warm checking glow while waiting for the AI judgement.
On success, play the next scene partner response when available.
On failure, show short AI feedback and keep the learner in the same card.

required_lines.purpose: Cue the situation and make the learner response necessary.
The line the user should learn to produce after hearing the cue.

optional_lines.purpose: Natural confirmation that the learner line worked. Play after a successful attempt when audio exists.

visual_rules: Every spoken dialogue line should have a visual frame.
Frame 0 should make the partner cue visually obvious.
Frame 1 should show the learner-character about to answer.
Frame 1 must remain visible during the learner prompt, microphone recording, and checking.
Prefer consistent recurring character roles across scenarios so the learner recognizes whose line they own.
Do not put readable target text, subtitles, or translations inside the image.
ai_contract_rules: Define the target function in plain English; do not rely on intent ids alone.
Use required semantic slots instead of only exact accepted phrases.
Include likely wrong intents so the AI can reject plausible but off-target utterances.
Ask for structured judgement fields that the learning engine can consume.
Do not let the AI continue into open conversation from this card.

practice_card_skeleton.prompt: Watch the scene once. Then replay the cue and say your part when prompted.
practice_card_skeleton.success_signal: learner hears the full scene, then successfully supplies the missing learner response
